brief: I built a Claude Code research analyst that beat my $8K/mo consultant. Here's how.

slots.step1Title: Slow turnaround on basic research tasks
slots.step1Sub: Waited three days for templated market maps.
slots.step2Title: Scattered data across too many tools
slots.step2Sub: Stacked five subscriptions with messy handoffs.
slots.step3Title: Generic output without real strategic insight
slots.step3Sub: Received surface-level briefs I could Google.

slots.step1Title: Install Claude Code inside your terminal
slots.step1Sub: One command turns your IDE into an agent.
slots.step2Sub: Switch between top LLMs without rewriting code.
slots.step3Title: Load a custom research prompt template
slots.step3Sub: Teach Claude your format and scoring criteria.

slots.step1Title: Pull target accounts from Apollo lists
slots.step1Sub: Export enriched leads directly into the workspace.
slots.step2Title: Verify contacts with Hunter in real time
slots.step2Sub: Append valid emails and reduce bounce rates.
slots.step3Title: Structure raw data into markdown tables
slots.step3Sub: Turn messy CSVs into readable research assets.

slots.step1Title: Run multi-step reasoning on market signals
slots.step1Sub: Connect news events to revenue and hiring trends.
slots.step2Sub: Spot budget windows before competitors do.
slots.step3Title: Flag buying intent from public job posts
slots.step3Sub: Identify pain points based on open roles.

slots.step1Sub: Distill ten sources into one clear narrative.
slots.step2Title: Export formatted briefs to Notion or Slack
slots.step2Sub: Share insights where your team already works.
slots.step3Title: Schedule daily runs with one cron job
slots.step3Sub: Wake up to fresh research without lifting a finger.

slots.step1Title: Cut research turnaround from days to minutes
slots.step1Sub: Deliver strategic briefs before your coffee cools.
slots.step2Title: Eliminated billable hours and scope creep
slots.step2Sub: Fixed cost replaces unpredictable monthly invoices.
slots.step3Title: Scaled output without adding any headcount
slots.step3Sub: One analyst now covers ten times the scope.

slots.body: I put the exact prompts, tool stack, and Claude Code config into a free guide. Grab it below.
